                                   Resolution 2022-15
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                  FOR THE PURCHASE OF FIRE TURNOUTS


WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) needs to replace 9 sets of fire turnouts that are past their 10-
year lifespan; and

WHEREAS, $25,000 will cover cost of turnouts as follows: $1,543.82 for coats and $1,078.89 for pants plus an
allowance for shipping,

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the purchase of 9 sets of turnouts at a cost not to
exceed $25,000 (TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS) from the GFR 406 Capital Account.




PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 18th day of July 2022.




Guy Wade
GBOS Fire Department Chair
